configProfiles.name: Default
configProfiles.content:
# BlockAds Unified Configuration Profile
#

[general]
dns_exclusion_list = *.local, localhost, *.lan
auto_reconnect = true
safe_search = true
youtube_restricted = false
firewall_enabled = true
daily_summary = true
milestone_notifications = true
theme = oled
language = pt-BR

[dns]
server = 1.1.1.3
server = 1.0.0.3

[policy]
static = DIRECT, direct
static = REJECT, reject

[filter_local]
host-suffix, bank.example.com, direct
host-suffix, cdn.example.net, direct
host-suffix, tracker.example.org, reject
host-wildcard, *.ads.example.com, reject
# host-suffix, disabled.example, reject
host-suffix, not a domain!, reject
ip-cidr, 10.0.0.0/8, direct
ip-cidr, 172.16.0.0/12, direct
ip-cidr, 192.168.0.0/16, direct
final, direct

[filter_remote]
https://raw.githubusercontent.com/StevenBlack/hosts/master/hosts, tag=StevenBlack_Unified, update-interval=24
https://easylist.to/easylist/easyprivacy.txt, tag=EasyPrivacy, update-interval=24
https://lists.example.org/my-own-list.txt, tag=My_Own_List, update-interval=24
http://insecure.example.org/list.txt, tag=Insecure, update-interval=24
# https://disabled.example.org/list.txt, tag=Disabled, update-interval=24

[app_whitelist]
com.example.bank
org.example.game

[firewall]
com.example.social, block_wifi=true, block_mobile=true, schedule=22:00-06:00, enabled=true
